Class MenuView.MenuItem

java.lang.Object
com.squad83.views.MenuView.MenuItem
Enclosing class:
MenuView
public static class MenuView.MenuItem extends Object
Model class representing a single row of the menu items table. Fields are stored as JavaFX properties so the table can bind to them.
Author:
Squad 83

  • Constructor Details

    • MenuItem

      public MenuItem(int id, String name, String category, String price, boolean active)
      Creates a menu item with the given values.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique menu item ID
      name - the display name of the item
      category - the menu category of the item
      price - the base price of the item, as text
      active - whether the item is currently active on the menu
